info.name: Moodle Collectives Sync
info.summary: Provisions Teams and Collectives from Moodle courses
info.description:
**Moodle Collectives Sync** connects course-driven learning in Moodle with real-time collaborative wikis in Nextcloud Collectives.
## Why Moodle Collectives Sync?
While Moodle excels at course management, grading, and enrolment, students often fall back on external, unmanaged tools — Google Docs, Notion — for shared notes and group documentation. Moodle Collectives Sync bridges that gap by bringing a dedicated, live-editable Nextcloud Collective into every activity, backed entirely by your own self-hosted Nextcloud.
## Key Capabilities
* **Automated Collective Provisioning:** Instantly creates a dedicated Nextcloud Collective the moment a teacher adds the activity in Moodle — no manual setup. * **Roster-Synced Membership:** Every enrolled student becomes a Collective member automatically, and membership stays in step as students join or leave the course. * **Embedded, Passwordless Access:** The wiki opens directly inside the Moodle activity — students are recognised from their Moodle session, no separate Nextcloud login required. * **Idempotent & Secure Sync:** HMAC-signed webhooks with replay protection between Moodle and Nextcloud guarantee reliable synchronisation without duplicate Collectives. * **Contribution Reporting:** Collaborative edits sync back to Moodle, so completion tracking and reports reflect real participation, not just a click. * **Enterprise Privacy & Compliance:** All documents, discussions, and student data stay inside your institution's own Nextcloud boundary (GDPR/FERPA friendly).
## Requirements & Documentation
* Nextcloud 32–34 * Nextcloud Collectives app (compatible version) * Moodle instance with the companion `mod_nextcloudcollective` plugin
